question: Which of the following classical dances is associated with Saint Srimanta Sankardev?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sattriya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sattriya dance** form was introduced in the 15th century A.D by** Srimanta Sankardev.**
 
• Sattriya dance is **one of the eight classical dance forms** of India.
 
• It was recognized as a classical dance by **Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.**
 
• It is a classical dance of **Assam.**
 
• The dance form evolved and expanded as a distinctive style of dance later on.
 
• Due to its religious character and association with the **Sattras**, this dance style has been aptly named Sattriya.
 
• Srimanta Sankardev was an** Assamese saint-scholar, poet, writer, dancer, actor, singer, artist, social-religious reformer, **and significant person in the cultural and religious history of **Assam, India**. Srimanta Sankardev lived in the 15th and 16th centuries.
